name: paymydine-cashier-desktop
description: PayMyDine universal cashier desktop app with physical printer, cash drawer and Virtual PDF print-debug support for Windows and macOS

scripts.check: npm run patch:v104 && node --check scripts/fetch-brand-icon.js && node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/setup.js && node --check src/hardware.js && node --check src/receipt.js && node --check src/hardware-page.js && node --check src/offline.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run patch:v104 && npm run brand:icon && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run patch:v104 && npm run brand:icon && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
